title: "About"
description: "About Data Insight."
---

Data Insight offers free, project-based data science training to learners who would otherwise have limited access to it. Since 2019, fellows have published more than a thousand projects on this site.

Data Insight is an initiative of [aai-services](https://github.com/aai-services).
